# East-bank 3D scenic models

Author and distributor: [Kenney, Nature Kit](https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit), version 2.1 as recorded in the original archive's `License.txt`. All three files below were taken unchanged from `Models/GLTF format/` in the official [Nature Kit archive](https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/nature-kit/37ac38a37b-1677698939/kenney_nature-kit.zip). [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/); the original license notice is in the parent `kenney-nature` folder. No external textures or runtime dependency.

Combined model sources: 53,228 bytes. Total authored instance geometry: 1,344 triangles before viewport culling/shadow passes, excluding the direction label. Client-only decoration; placements avoid the bridge deck and do not change collision data, 2D, inventory, or the existing interactive East Bank flower.
